entries.name: Monstro’s Belly Brawl
entries.instructions: Enter Monstro’s Room of Truth for the story Shadow battle. Defeat Heartless quickly to fill the meter. If it empties, leave and re-enter the Room of Truth to retry.

entries.name: Balloon Glider
entries.instructions: At the Hunny Tree, approach the balloons tied to the log. Reach the top while avoiding branches and bees; losing every balloon ends the attempt. First clear: Firaga Burst. Second clear: Stop 0.

entries.name: Whirlwind Plunge
entries.instructions: At Muddy Road, jump onto the well with rising air. Collect honey while holding Pooh; use the reaction command to recover him after a collision. First clear: Mega-Ether 5. Second clear: Gravity 9.

entries.name: Bumble-Rumble
entries.instructions: At Muddy Road, approach the honey hole in the tree. Protect Pooh with the supplied Attack, Wind and Honey cards. First clear: Elixir 1 after the 50-bee objective. Second clear: Hi-Potion 7. The achievement uses the 70-bee replay.

entries.name: Tigger’s Jump-a-Thon
entries.instructions: Return to Tigger’s Playground and repeat Tigger’s four-stump button sequence. The initial clear requires 25 correct jumps. First clear: Idyll Romp. Second clear: Ether 9.

entries.name: Veggie Panic
entries.instructions: Talk to Rabbit after the Rabbit’s House scene. Send cabbages left and pumpkins right; use Strike Raid on large pumpkins or to protect Pooh. The initial clear requires 30 vegetables. First clear: Cross-slash+. Second clear: Fire 8.
